install.notes: The upstream environment is SAPIEN 1.1.1 over Vulkan and needs a GPU plus the PartNet Mobility assets (environment.yml:87-152, install.gpu true). The gate and the fake backend need none of that: fake.py is pure Python. Install the upstream package only to serve the sim backend (gym.make('OpenCabinetDoor-v0')), which was not run.
